008package paint.shared.utils;
009
010import com.dd.plist.NSDictionary;
011import com.dd.plist.NSObject;
012import com.dd.plist.PropertyListParser;
013
014import java.io.File;
015
016/**
017 * Provides static, thread-safe access to application preferences for Glyco-PAINT.
018 * <p>
019 * Preferences are stored in {@code ~/Library/Preferences/Glyco-PAINT.plist} using
020 * Apple’s Property List (plist) format. The class handles reading, writing, and
021 * automatic persistence of key-value pairs for various data types.
022 * </p>
023 * <ul>
024 *   <li>Thread-safe access (synchronized methods)</li>
025 *   <li>Automatic saving of preferences after updates</li>
026 *   <li>Reload capability for external modifications</li>
027 *   <li>Fallback to default values if keys are missing</li>
028 * </ul>
029 */
030public final class PaintPrefs {
031
032    /**
033     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
034     */
035    private PaintPrefs() {
036        // Deliberately empty
037    }
038
039    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
040    // CONSTANTS AND STATE
041    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
042
043    private static final File PREF_FILE = new File(
044            System.getProperty("user.home"),
045            "Library/Preferences/Glyco-PAINT.plist"
046    );
047
048    private static NSDictionary plist = new NSDictionary();
049
050    static {
051        try {
052            if (PREF_FILE.exists()) {
053                plist = (NSDictionary) PropertyListParser.parse(PREF_FILE);
054            }
055        } catch (Exception e) {
056            PaintLogger.errorf("Could not load plist: " + e.getMessage());
057            plist = new NSDictionary();
058        }
059    }
060
061
062    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
063    // GET METHODS
064    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
065
066    /**
067     * Retrieves a boolean preference value or writes the given default if not present.
068     *
069     * @param section      section name (namespace)
070     * @param key          preference key
071     * @param defaultValue default to return and store if missing
072     * @return stored boolean or default
073     */
074    public static synchronized boolean getBoolean(
075            String section,
076            String key,
077            boolean defaultValue) {
078        NSDictionary sectionDict = (NSDictionary) plist.objectForKey(section);
079        if (sectionDict == null) {
080            sectionDict = new NSDictionary();
081            plist.put(section, sectionDict);
082        }
083        NSObject obj = sectionDict.objectForKey(key);
084        if (obj == null) {
085            sectionDict.put(key, defaultValue);
086            save();
087            return defaultValue;
088        }
089        return Boolean.parseBoolean(obj.toString());
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Retrieves a string preference value or writes the given default if missing.
094     *
095     * @param section      section name (namespace)
096     * @param key          preference key
097     * @param defaultValue default to return and store if missing
098     * @return stored string or default
099     */
100    public static synchronized String getString(
101            String section,
102            String key,
103            String defaultValue) {
104        NSDictionary sectionDict = (NSDictionary) plist.objectForKey(section);
105        if (sectionDict == null) {
106            sectionDict = new NSDictionary();
107            plist.put(section, sectionDict);
108        }
109        NSObject obj = sectionDict.objectForKey(key);
110        if (obj == null) {
111            sectionDict.put(key, defaultValue);
112            save();
113            return defaultValue;
114        }
115        return obj.toString();
116    }
117
118    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
119    // PUT METHODS (SECTIONED)
120    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
121
122    /**
123     * Stores a boolean value within a named section and persists the change.
124     */
125    public static synchronized void putBoolean(
126            String section,
127            String key,
128            boolean value) {
129        NSDictionary sectionDict = (NSDictionary) plist.objectForKey(section);
130        if (sectionDict == null) {
131            sectionDict = new NSDictionary();
132            plist.put(section, sectionDict);
133        }
134        sectionDict.put(key, value);
135        save();
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * Stores a string value within a named section and persists the change.
140     */
141    public static synchronized void putString(
142            String section,
143            String key,
144            String value) {
145        NSDictionary sectionDict = (NSDictionary) plist.objectForKey(section);
146        if (sectionDict == null) {
147            sectionDict = new NSDictionary();
148            plist.put(section, sectionDict);
149        }
150        sectionDict.put(key, value);
151        save();
152    }
153
154
155    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
156    // FILE MANAGEMENT
157    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
158
159    /**
160     * Saves the current preferences to the plist file.
161     * Logs an error via {@link PaintLogger} if saving fails.
162     */
163    private static synchronized void save() {
164        try {
165            PropertyListParser.saveAsXML(plist, PREF_FILE);
166        } catch (Exception e) {
167            PaintLogger.errorf("Could not save plist: %s", e.getMessage());
168        }
169    }
170}
